main_text.p: extincta. Ideo non opus est mira-culis, quia non ad ecclesiam nova exstruendam, sed ad veterem mise-rè collapsam erigendam & reformandam excitati sunt. Plura de mi-raculorum productione vide in loco de miraculis. Interea audiatur Acosta de procur. Ind. salute l.2.cap.9. Re-ligio Christiana, ubi humana præ-sidia prorsus aberant, divinis est fundata miraculis: at nostrorum temporum longè alia est ratio. Item Unum illud huic novo orbi poten-tissimum & ad fidem efficacissimū, & pene singulare miraculū necessarium est. Mores cum fide cōgruentes: hoc abundè sufficit in hoc ignorum argumento explicando. & paulo post. Non ergo fides, jam satis firmata, miraculis novis indiget confirmari, quin potius utilius esse asserit, signis nunc carere, quoniam majoris meriti sit sine illis credere.
16 Absurdum esse, & impium, vel sanè rem plenam periculi, permittere vo-candi & eligendi auctoritatem cæca mul-titudi-

page.notes: Line 1 begins with the fragment "extincta.", so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. The text ends on "titudi-" with its hyphen, as printed. Two words in the Acosta reference and in "paulo post" are set in a small italic and are read with some doubt; "Acosta" is read from the long-s form "Acosta". The line "ignorum argumento" may be misread (possibly "ignorantium") and should be checked against the scan. No catchword or signature is printed.
